quarterly_data.quarter: Anji Microelectronics results briefing Q&A: 2025 annual collective (05-07-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Chairman Wang Shumin (2025 annual collective results briefing): the Shanghai Jinqiao base mainly makes CMP slurries, Ningbo Beilun mainly functional wet chemicals, and the Shanghai Chemical Industry Park base (main building topped out) will mainly make upstream raw materials. The convertible-bond project's Shanghai IC materials base will add 8,000 tonnes of etch solutions (self-funded), 3,400 tonnes of new-formula process chemicals and related products (plating solutions and additives), 1,200 tonnes of electronic-grade additives and 500 tonnes of nano abrasives; Ningbo Anji will add 10,000 tonnes of photoresist removers (post-etch cleans), 5,000 tonnes of post-CMP cleans and 400 tonnes of electronic-grade additives. The plating-solution and additive platform and one-stop delivery are in place with localised supply ramping; it is building a team and local lab in Taiwan, with technical-cooperation projects and product validations progressing. General manager Zhang Ming said gross margin will be kept in a healthy range with 'long-term stability' as the goal.
quarterly_data.figure: Shanghai base adds 8,000 tonnes of etch solutions; Ningbo adds 10,000 tonnes of photoresist removers
